args.sql:
WITH good_living_cabins AS (
    SELECT cabinregistry
    FROM cabinenvironment
    WHERE 
        cabinclimate->>'temperature_c' BETWEEN '18' AND '24'
        AND cabinclimate->>'o2_percent' > '19.5'
        AND cabinclimate->>'co2_ppm' < '1000'
        AND ventilationstatus = 'On'
        AND heaterstatus = 'On'
)
UPDATE equipment
SET reliabilityindex = reliabilityindex * 1.01
WHERE equipmentcode IN (
    SELECT cabineqref
    FROM good_living_cabins
)
